\FloatBarrier\section{Active native schematic and GUI results}

M1 converts RF gate voltage into current; M2/M3 steer the shared current with complementary LO phases. R1/R2 return to VDD and convert IF current to differential voltage. No additional tail current source is placed below M1.

\nativetestbenchfigure{active_gui_testbench.png}{Actual Virtuoso GUI native image export of the saved active mixer testbench. Exact device values and D/G/S/B connections are listed in the accompanying tables.}{fig:active-testbench}

$C_{GS}$ and $C_{GD}$ are intrinsic BSIM4 parasitics; do not add them as discrete parts. CLP/CLN are explicit output loads. The installed symbol has no separate finger-count CDF field; each device uses multiplier 1.

The static bias solution does not establish transistor region throughout LO commutation. Use the settled measured extrema to assess headroom. Capacitive LO feedthrough can briefly push an active output beyond VDD. FFT bin amplitudes do not measure a stochastic noise floor.
